label: class_e_02_battle_01
text: Another day, another round of battle study! Osu!\nLet’s get right to it![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_02
text: Is everyone excited about the Treasure Hunt?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_03
text: It’s always a great adventure! You get to take on\nGyms, go to new places, and run all over the\r\nplace with your partner Pokémon![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_04
text: And, while you’re running around out there,\nI’ll bet you’ll come across some big, shining\r\n[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]crystals [VAR 0xFF00(0000)]fairly often as well.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_05
text: These crystals are actually collections of Terastal\nenergy that’s seeped up out of the ground![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_06
text: You can check out these crystals to battle Tera\nPokémon with your friends or other Trainers in a\r\ngroup of four.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_07
text: We call those battles...Tera Raid Battles![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_08
text: The Tera Pokémon you’ll face off against in Tera\nRaid Battles are crazy tough![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_09
text: They sometimes act differently than regular\nPokémon, so you’ll need to be on your guard![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_10
text: Luckily, Trainers can also use a special action in\nTera Raid Battles. It’s called [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]cheering[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_11
text: And there are three different cheers you can use![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_12
text: The first cheer is “[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Go all out![VAR 0xFF00(0000)]” It boosts the\nAttack and Sp. Atk of all ally Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_13
text: The second is “[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Hang tough![VAR 0xFF00(0000)]” This one boosts\nthe Defense and Sp. Def of all ally Pokémon.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_14
text: And the third— Well, let’s see if you can guess![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_15
text: This cheer restores HP for all ally Pokémon.\nWhat do you think it is?[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_select_01
text: Heal up!

label: class_e_02_select_02
text: Wham-Bam Potion!

label: class_e_02_select_03
text: Explosive healing wave!

label: class_e_02_battle_answer_01
text: That’s right! Maybe I should make YOU the battle\nteacher, huh, new kid?![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_answer_02
text: Wham-Bam Potion?! That sounds less like a cheer\nand more like a seriously heavy-handed medical\r\ntreatment or something![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_answer_03
text: Explosive healing wave?! That’s a wild answer if\nI ever heard one! But I think I’d like to give that\r\nmove a whirl if it really existed![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_16
text: The third and final cheer is “[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Heal up![VAR 0xFF00(0000)]” It’s a real\npowerhouse, with the ability to both restore HP\r\nand cure status conditions![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_17
text: You can cheer up to three times during a single\nTera Raid Battle.[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_18
text: Also, cheering uses up a turn in battle, so you\nwon’t be able to have your Pokémon use any of\r\ntheir moves when you cheer![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_19
text: In conclusion![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_20
text: Try everything at your disposal! If nothing seems\nto be working, try cheering on your allies![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_21
text: Providing support for your team can sometimes\nopen up a new realm of possibilities![VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_22
text: Aw, man! I was just about to suggest we do some\nhands-on practice to really drive the point home,\r\nbut I guess we’re out of time...[VAR 0x0114(0024)]

label: class_e_02_battle_23
text: Class is over for now! Take care, you little rascals![VAR 0x0114(0024)]
